payload.instruction: Change the image into pencil drawing
payload.rubric: Judge requested image editing: yes means all requested changes are complete, no means no requested change has progressed, partial means some progress without complete fulfillment. Unrelated edits are not requested progress. Insufficient evidence stays unresolved.

outcome.description: Transform the image into a pencil drawing.
outcome.target: The image is rendered as a pencil drawing, with its visual content represented in a pencil-drawn style.
outcome.reference: The supplied image and the requested pencil-drawing transformation.

check.question: Does the image visibly appear as a completed pencil drawing?
check.complete_when: The image is visibly rendered throughout as a pencil drawing.
check.partial_when: Visible pencil-drawing treatment is present, but the transformation is incomplete or only affects part of the image.
check.absent_when: There is confident evidence that no pencil-drawing transformation has been made.
check.unknown_when: The image or its style cannot be assessed confidently.

response.content: {"status":"partial","evidence":"The edited image has a muted, grainy, pencil-like treatment across the scene, but it retains substantial color and photographic shading rather than appearing fully rendered as a pencil drawing."}

parsed.evidence: The edited image has a muted, grainy, pencil-like treatment across the scene, but it retains substantial color and photographic shading rather than appearing fully rendered as a pencil drawing.
